defects.title: Collapsed Lantern / Amalaka Summit
defects.probable_cause: Historical seismic shaking combined with missing tie timbers
defects.conservation_action: Install weather-resistant titanium internal tie anchors and non-invasive protective cap

defects.title: Fractured Portico Entrance Lintel
defects.probable_cause: Differential overburden load from upper pediment pedimentation
defects.conservation_action: Hydraulic lime micro-grouting and external carbon-fiber rod reinforcement

defects.title: Western Plinth Salt Sub-efflorescence & Spalling
defects.dimensions: Surface area ~3.2 sq. meters, Relief loss 15-40mm
defects.probable_cause: Capillary groundwater rise carrying Salt Range halite minerals
defects.conservation_action: Cellulose poultice desalination followed by sacrificial lime rendering

defects.title: North-East Facade Joint Leaching & Mortar Loss
defects.probable_cause: Intense seasonal monsoon rainwater washing through dry ashlar joints
defects.conservation_action: Deep pointing with natural hydraulic lime (NHL 3.5) mortar

defects.title: Bio-Crust & Lichen Colonization
defects.probable_cause: High relative humidity in shaded vertical flutes during winter
defects.conservation_action: Biocidal wash (quaternary ammonium compound) with soft bristle brush
